title: Mount Iraya Agta language
displaytitle: Mount Iraya Agta language

titles.display: Mount Iraya Agta language

extract: Mount Iraya Agta is a Bikol language spoken by a semi-nomadic hunter-gatherer Agta (Negrito) people of the Philippines, east of Lake Buhi in Luzon. It is mutually intelligible with Mount Iriga Agta on the other side of the lake.
